why: Removes the volume slider's 44 px height. It is the one menu control that is not a `.ui-btn`, so the primitive's floor never reaches it: measured in Chromium before issue #686 it rendered 140x16, the smallest target in Settings, and a sweep over `.ui-btn` alone would report Settings as fixed with it still there.
